# Arthavi (llms.txt)

> Arthavi is a privacy-first portfolio tracker for Indian investors that imports CAS statements, with no broker login. For comprehensive documentation, feature benchmarks, competitor analyses, and security architecture, read [llms-full.txt](https://arthavi.com/llms-full.txt).

## Core Documentation & LLM Resources

- [Full LLM Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)](https://arthavi.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive documentation covering product architecture, competitive matrix, CAS parsing methodology, security specifications, and tool descriptions.
- [Privacy Model](https://arthavi.com/privacy-model/): Detailed breakdown of data collection, encryption, and why Arthavi never reads emails or requires broker passwords.
- [Methodology](https://arthavi.com/methodology/): Technical documentation on CAS parsing pipeline, XIRR calculation (Newton-Raphson), market data sources, and overlap detection algorithm.

## Alternatives & Comparisons

- [Compare Portfolio Trackers Hub](https://arthavi.com/compare/): Side-by-side benchmark comparing Arthavi against MProfit, INDmoney, Value Research, Dezerv, Kuvera, Zerodha, and Excel.
- [Best MProfit Alternative](https://arthavi.com/alternatives/mprofit/): Free, cloud-based MProfit alternative with honest comparison table on pricing, privacy, import, family support, and AI.
- [Best INDmoney Alternative](https://arthavi.com/alternatives/indmoney/): Privacy-first INDmoney alternative — no email scraping, no data selling, no spam calls.
- [Best Kuvera Alternative](https://arthavi.com/alternatives/kuvera/): Independent Kuvera alternative after the Groww acquisition — not owned by any broker.
- [Arthavi vs MProfit (Detailed)](https://arthavi.com/arthavi-vs-mprofit/): Detailed breakdown of the modern, free MProfit alternative for Indian retail and family investors.
- [Arthavi vs INDmoney (Detailed)](https://arthavi.com/arthavi-vs-indmoney/): In-depth comparison of INDmoney's email-scraping model vs Arthavi's privacy-first approach.
- [Arthavi vs Value Research Online](https://arthavi.com/arthavi-vs-valueresearch/): Fund research tool vs modern portfolio tracking and AI portfolio doctor.
- [Arthavi vs Dezerv](https://arthavi.com/arthavi-vs-dezerv/): DIY automated portfolio tracking vs high-fee managed wealth advisory.
- [Arthavi vs Zerodha Console](https://arthavi.com/arthavi-vs-zerodha/): Single-broker console vs cross-broker family consolidation.
- [Arthavi vs Groww](https://arthavi.com/arthavi-vs-groww/): Execution broker app vs unbiased portfolio health check.
- [Arthavi vs Excel](https://arthavi.com/arthavi-vs-excel/): Why manual spreadsheets fail for tracking Indian portfolios and how Arthavi automates XIRR.

## Free Tools (No Login Required)

- [XIRR Calculator](https://arthavi.com/tools/xirr-calculator/): Calculate true XIRR for SIPs and mutual funds using Newton-Raphson iteration. Add cash flows, generate SIP series, get annualized return.
- [SIP Return Calculator](https://arthavi.com/tools/sip-return-calculator/): Project SIP wealth with step-up and inflation adjustment. Calculates final corpus for any tenure.
- [Mutual Fund Overlap Checker](https://arthavi.com/tools/mutual-fund-overlap/): Compare two mutual funds and see percentage of shared underlying stocks. Identifies concentration risk.
- [LTCG/STCG Tax Calculator](https://arthavi.com/tools/ltcg-stcg-calculator/): Calculate capital gains tax on equity and debt mutual funds for FY 2025-26. Updated with Budget 2024 rates.
- [All Calculators Hub](https://arthavi.com/calculators/): Complete suite including SIP, SWP, CAGR, XIRR, Lumpsum, EMI, FD, PPF, NPS, HRA, Income Tax, and GST calculators.

## Guides

- [How to Track Mutual Funds and Stocks in One Place](https://arthavi.com/guides/how-to-track-mutual-funds-and-stocks-in-one-place/): Step-by-step guide to consolidating MF + stock portfolios. Upload CAS, add stocks, get unified XIRR.
- [CAS Statement Explained](https://arthavi.com/guides/cas-statement-explained/): What is a Consolidated Account Statement, what it contains, how to download, and how to use for portfolio tracking.
- [How to Import CAS from CAMS, KFintech & NSDL](https://arthavi.com/guides/how-to-import-cas-cams-kfintech-nsdl/): Step-by-step instructions for downloading and importing CAS into Arthavi.

## Primary Pages

- [Homepage](https://arthavi.com/): India's privacy-first wealth dashboard. Calculate true XIRR, analyze mutual fund overlap, and get AI insights from read-only CAS statements.

- [Complete Feature List](https://arthavi.com/features/): Detailed list of all 42+ tracking capabilities, CAS import tools, manual entries, security layers, and investment planning tools.
- [AI Portfolio Analyzer](https://arthavi.com/ai-portfolio-analyzer-market-research/): Platform information on the AI portfolio assistant and financial query engine.
- [Ask AI Investment Assistant](https://arthavi.com/ask-ai-investment-assistant/): How the AI assistant offers portfolio-aware sector, overlap, and XIRR analytics without broker logins.
- [Security](https://arthavi.com/security/): AES-256 encryption, TLS 1.3, zero email scraping, and data protection commitments.
- [Privacy Policy](https://arthavi.com/privacy/): Legal privacy policy.
- [Interactive Demo](https://app.arthavi.com/demo): Try the full portfolio dashboard without creating an account.
